name: Deana Carlsait
source:
Alongside [url=/c46516]Claudie[/url] she's one of the best court magicians in Avenchurine.
She loves pretty and cute things, but she's a strong willed woman.
She feels inferior when comparing herself to Claudie and doesn't want to lose to him.
